text:
I’ve learned to get nervous when somebody knows too much about me too soon. We’re twin flames. She knows my motives. I’m Lord Krishna. Okay, maybe I really am way better than the other guys she’s found. But if she hasn’t found anything about me that bothers her yet, she hasn’t found all of me.

I still love women I loved before her. Sometimes I talk about them because I’m thinking about them. I’m not trying to make her jealous, and she can tell me, “Can you talk less about your exes?” Sure. What I can’t do is pretend those women stopped mattering to me because a new relationship started.

If everything in her heart gets to be real while mine has to be cleaned up first, that’s not going to work for me.
